arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.city = 'Rome' AND ml.state = 'GA'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant location is Rome, GA.
assumptions: Rome, Georgia is taken as city = 'Rome' and state = 'GA' on the merchant location.
Counts all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label or an error.
Covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
